source.title: ESR1 mutation as an emerging clinical biomarker in metastatic hormone receptor-positive breast cancer

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented to primary literature and has no dedicated review-synthesis or secondary-reported-result atom kind. Review-level trial summaries were retained with explicit canonical wording and tags indicating secondary provenance.
extraction_limitations: This is a narrative review, not a primary study. Numeric clinical results are secondary reports anchored to the review pages and should not be treated as substitutes for extraction from the cited primary publications.
Pure bibliography entries were not atomized.
Review methods do not provide a systematic search strategy or formal risk-of-bias assessment. This is an appraisal observation, not a reported study result.
